name: argonaute RISC component 1
pathways: positive regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: AGO1 encodes protein argonaute-1. Annotated molecular activities include miRNA binding and double-stranded RNA binding. It participates in regulatory ncRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing and positive regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder with language delay and behavioral abnormalities, with or without seizures (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: AGO1 encodes protein argonaute-1. It is required for RNA-mediated gene silencing (RNAi). It binds to short RNAs such as microRNAs (miRNAs) or short interfering RNAs (siRNAs), and represses the translation of mRNAs which are complementary to them. It is also required for transcriptional gene silencing (TGS) of promoter regions which are complementary to bound short antigene RNAs (agRNAs).

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder with language delay and behavioral abnormalities, with or without seizures (autosomal dominant).
